aegis-dataset/aegis-dataset/scans/scanne.text: APPENDIX C — SENSOR CALIBRATION RECORD. Aegis Series-7 HCS (scanned from field service binder, uncontrolled copy). Sensor Tag: PS-04A. Location: HPU discharge line. Calibration Date: 2026-01-09. Technician: R. Okafor. Calibration points: Zero (0%), reference 0 bar, reading 0.1 bar, PASS; Mid (50%), reference 100 bar, reading 99.6 bar, PASS; Span (100%), reference 200 bar, reading 199.4 bar, PASS. This calibration record supersedes the field data sheet used prior to the PS-04 to PS-04A sensor change (see ECN-1042). Span reference target is 200 bar, consistent with software revision 3.2 operating pressure setpoint. Prior sensor PS-04 span reference target was 180 bar — for historical comparison only. Do not use the 180 bar figure to evaluate PS-04A. No calibration interval is specified for PS-04A on this form; recalibration frequency should be confirmed against the applicable maintenance schedule, which is not included in this binder.

aegis-dataset/aegis-dataset/diagrams/sys.text: Visual reading of AEG-DWG-H01: labelled shapes include PLC-03 (HCS Controller), PS-04A, Hydraulic Power Unit (HPU), IV-21, Main Reservoir, Auxiliary Reservoir, and Press Circuit. The legend assigns purple lines to control/signal connections to PLC-03, grey lines to hydraulic fluid paths, and tan lines to a reservoir interconnect. Purple connection lines visibly run from PLC-03 to PS-04A and from PLC-03 to IV-21. A grey line is also drawn between the PLC-03 shape and the HPU shape, despite the legend defining grey as hydraulic fluid path; this is ambiguous and should not be silently classified as an electrical controller connection. Grey hydraulic lines also connect HPU, PS-04A, reservoirs, press circuit, and IV-21. A tan line interconnects the Main Reservoir and Auxiliary Reservoir.

Visual reading of AEG-DWG-E02: Main Disconnect Q1 is above Control Transformer T1 marked 480:120V. The drawing also shows PLC-03 24VDC Power Supply, PLC-03 I/O Rack, E-STOP Safety Relay KA1, Sensor Loop Power 24VDC, and IV-21 Valve Driver. Notes under Sensor Loop Power state it feeds the pressure transducer loop and refer to wiring diagram AEG-DWG-W03. A faint rotated label reads TB-7, ref: pressure transducer loop. No voltage sensor or 3-phase supply rating is labelled in the supplied drawing.
